growth_thesis.basis: Stated in P1; the conditional language ('subject to', 'negotiating an extension') is explicit in the filing.
growth_thesis.claim: New concession awards in Iraq (Baghdad International Airport, November 2025) and Angola (AIAAN, December 2025) represent geographic expansion into new markets. For these to become revenue, the definitive PPP/concession agreements must be executed, customary conditions precedent satisfied, and the operating environments must remain stable enough to support commercial aviation.

Ltd. signed an award agreement with the Government of Iraq to operate the Baghdad International Airport. In December 2025, the consortium formed by the Company, Mota-Engil Engenharia e Construção Africa and BestFly Ltda. was formally notified by the Angolan Ministry of Transport of the award of the public tender for the concession of the right to operate and manage the Dr. António Agostinho Neto International Airport ("AIAAN"), subject to the execution of the definitive concession agreement and the satisfaction of customary conditions precedent.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in P3 (plan details); leverage context from F1 balance sheet.
growth_thesis.claim: Planned capital investment programmes—€576 million for Florence and Pisa (Italy) and U.S.$425 million for Zvartnots (Armenia) by 2033—will expand capacity and generate construction-service revenue. For these to proceed, Italian regulatory approvals (ENAC) and Armenian government sign-off must be obtained, and the company must secure funding without materially increasing leverage.
quotes: We and the Italian aviation authority (ENAC) are currently in discussions to develop a €576 million infrastructure plan for the Florence and Pisa Airports.

In Armenia, we submitted to the Armenian Government a new master plan including a capital investment program of U.S.$425 million to be executed by 2033, covering infrastructure development, operational enhancements, and long-term capacity at Zvartnots International Airport.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in P3 (revenue tables) and P1 (Carrasco investment).

For this trend to continue, passenger volumes must keep rising, per-passenger spend must hold or increase, and the company must continue expanding retail and F&B space (e.g., the 20% Dufry departure-area expansion at Carrasco).
quotes: In 2025, in the Carrasco Airport located near Montevideo, Uruguay, we invested in a new instrument landing system, built new covered parking, expanded VIP lounge and cargo business, and began works to expand Dufry departure area by 20%.
